_comment: App-owned scheduled-job type for the Business Central multi-company fan-out sync. Its DriverClass points at BizAppsAccountingBCFanOutSyncDriver, a @RegisterClass driver in @mj-biz-apps/accounting-server (loaded into MJAPI via the app's server dynamic-package). The driver reads Configuration.IntegrationID and runs one IntegrationEngine.RunSync per active, credentialed Company Integration for that integration. Kept in the app repo on purpose -- the stock IntegrationSyncScheduledJobDriver targets a single CompanyIntegrationID; multi-company fan-out is an app concern, not an MJ platform change.

fields.Name: BizApps Accounting - Business Central Fan-Out Sync
fields.Description: Runs the Business Central GL account sync for every active, credentialed Company Integration of a given Integration in one job (fan-out), with per-company failure isolation. Configuration: { IntegrationID, EntityMapIDs?, FullSync?, SyncDirection? }. Driver: BizAppsAccountingBCFanOutSyncDriver (in @mj-biz-apps/accounting-server).
